record.field:
Hidroconta · Odoo Integration

1) Connection (Remote Control)

Type: REST · Base URL: https://demeter2.hidroconta.com

connection_params (JSON):

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
  "password": "********"
}
  • Login → performs POST /Demeter2/v2/login with username and password in JSON body, stores JSESSIONID cookie.
  • Subsequent requests must include the JSESSIONID cookie.

2) Available Procedures

The following predefined procedures are included in this module:

  • Hidroconta: Get Devices → Login + retrieves installations and all devices grouped by type and installation.
  • Hidroconta: Daily Sync → Login + Build Sensor Plan + Get Readings for automatic daily synchronization.

3) Typical Workflow

  1. Login → authenticates the user and stores bag["jsessionid"].
  2. Get Devices → calls:
    • GET /Demeter2/v2/installations → retrieves all installations with their codes and descriptions.
    • POST /Demeter2/v2/search → retrieves devices by type (counters, valves, hydrants, analogInputs, digitalInputs, digitalOutputs, iris, rtus).
    Generates a JSON attachment with all information grouped by installation: hidroconta_devices_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json.
  3. Build Sensor Plan → builds bag["sensor_plan"] with (element_id, subtype, subcode, start_date) for each configured sensor.
  4. Get Readings → executes POST /Demeter2/v2/history/data for each sensor in the plan and updates readings in Odoo.

4) Authentication

Required cookie:

Cookie: JSESSIONID=<session_id>

Login endpoint:

POST /Demeter2/v2/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
  "password": "password123"
}

Response: JSESSIONID cookie in Set-Cookie header

5) Odoo Configuration

In Device (mdm.measurement.device) remotecontrol_params:

{
  "start_date": "2025-01-01"
}
  • element_id: Device identifier in Hidroconta API
  • subtype: Data type (4 for standard readings)
  • subcode: Data subtype (0 for default, varies by device type)
  • start_date: Initial date for historical data retrieval (YYYY-MM-DD)

In Sensor (mdm.measurement.device.sensor) remotecontrol_params:

{
  "element_id": 22145,
  "subtype": 4,
  "subcode": 0,
}

6) Endpoints Used

  • POST /Demeter2/v2/login → obtain JSESSIONID cookie for authentication.
  • GET /Demeter2/v2/installations → list all installations with codes and descriptions.
  • POST /Demeter2/v2/search → search devices by type and status (payload: {"status": "enabled", "types": ["counters"]}).
  • POST /Demeter2/v2/history/data → retrieve historical readings for specific devices.

7) Device Types

The following device types are supported:

  • counters → Water meters and consumption counters
  • valves → Control valves
  • hydrants → Hydrant devices
  • analogInputs → Analog input sensors
  • digitalInputs → Digital input sensors
  • digitalOutputs → Digital output controls
  • iris → IRIS communication devices
  • rtus → Remote Terminal Units

8) Generated File Structure

The JSON attachment hidroconta_devices_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json contains:

{
  "executed_at": "2025-12-23 10:30:00",
  "installations": {
    "12345": {
      "installation_id": 12345,
      "installation_name": "Installation Name (CODE)",
      "devices_by_type": {
        "counters": [...],
        "valves": [...],
        "hydrants": [...]
      }
    }
  },
  "errors": []
}

9) Readings

The reading flow executes POST /Demeter2/v2/history/data with the following payload:

{
  "from": "01/12/2025 00:00:00",
  "until": "18/12/2025 12:00:00",
  "elementIds": [22145],
  "subtype": 4,
  "subcode": [0]
}

Results are stored in mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading:

  • Key: (sensor_id, measurement_time) (updates if already exists).
  • Timestamps from historicDate field are converted to YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
  • The numeric value from value field is stored.

10) Recommendations

  • Run Get Devices first to map all installations and devices before configuring sensors.
  • Verify that each sensor in Odoo has the proper element_id, subtype, and subcode defined.
  • The start_date parameter determines the initial date for historical data retrieval.
  • If a sensor already has readings, the system automatically starts from the last reading timestamp.
  • The JSON attachment can be downloaded from the attachments list of the remotecontrol record.
  • All requests require a valid JSESSIONID cookie obtained from the Login action.
